newsitem.title: USA: Herzog sales rise 15 pct first half of Nov.
newsitem.headline: Herzog sales rise 15 pct first half of Nov.

text.p: German men's leather and sportswear maker Herzog said its sales increased 15 percent in the first two weeks of November, compared with the same period a year ago.
The first two weeks in November is the time of year when all the orders for the upcoming fashion season take place in Germany, Lynne Sifford, a spokeswoman for Herzog said.
Herzog also said it will earn 1.5 million marks (US $1 million) this fiscal year, which ended October 31, on revenues of 10 million marks.
Herzog was bought by Xebes Galleon Inc on November 5. Its name will be changed to Herzog International Holdings Inc. in the next few weeks.
